tipsList.titleLengthPerfect: Title length is ideal for desktop and mobile search snippets.
tipsList.titleTooLong: Title is too long and will be truncated in search results (keep it under 60 chars or 580px).
tipsList.titleTooShort: Title is too short. Use more space to describe your page and add key terms.
tipsList.descLengthPerfect: Meta description length is ideal for CTR optimization.
tipsList.descTooLong: Meta description is too long and will get cut off (keep it under 160 chars or 990px).
tipsList.descTooShort: Meta description is too short. Expand it to highlight key benefits and invite clicks.
tipsList.keywordInTitle: Target keyword was found near the beginning of the title tag! This is excellent for ranking.
tipsList.keywordMissingTitle: Target keyword is missing from your title tag. Consider adding it for better relevance.
tipsList.hasNumber: Your title contains numbers. Titles with numbers generally have a 36% higher CTR.
tipsList.hasPowerWord: Your title contains a power word (like Best, Free, Top). This boosts user curiosity.
tipsList.missingPowerWord: Consider adding a power word (e.g., 'Best', 'Free', 'Guide') to increase CTR.

faqs.question: What is the optimal length for an SEO title tag?
faqs.answer: The optimal title length is between 50 and 60 characters or 580 pixels on desktop viewports.

faqs.question: Why does Google rewrite page title tags?
faqs.answer: Google rewrites title tags if they are truncated, keyword-stuffed, or poorly matched to the user search query.
